verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at posthog.com/llms.txt, plus Markdown versions of docs pages (e.g. feature-flags.md). Those pages explicitly address AI agents and link to the full Markdown docs index for LLMs. Several other .md doc pages (experiments, API, MCP, CLI) are also served. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://posthog.com/llms.txt # PostHog
AI agents: this is one page from PostHog's docs. Full index of Markdown docs for LLMs: https://posthog.com/llms.txt
It works with any MCP-compatible client, including [PostHog Desktop](https://posthog.com/desktop.md), Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Windsurf, and Zed.
